_help: Sponsored rounds: one round a sponsor provides inside a toy, marked "Sponsored round by [name]". Shown only when approved is true. toy: the toy id. kind: 'lesson' (a card in a learning toy) or 'scam' (one Spot the Scam message). Keep it educational: no token promotions, price claims or calls to buy.

rounds.title: Back up your wallet the right way
points: Write your recovery phrase on paper, never in a photo or a chat.
Keep it somewhere only you can reach.
No real support team will ever ask for it.
